# EWS callback ownership belongs inside its safe wrapper constructor

The historical SafeEwsFolderCallbacks constructor accepts an IEwsFolderCallbacks reference and creates RefPtr inside the wrapper before detached async work. The wrapper validates optional IDs/names and converts values before unsafe callbacks; callback errors remain fallible. Review separates shared ownership/reference counting from bare lifetime wording and initially defers a separate generic crate. Fixed code now uses shared SafeListenerWrapper and IExchangeFolderListener, so the old interface is historical. Other callbacks still needed a compatibility adapter at the landing; this did not remove every unsafe call. No Rust build or memory test ran.

Scope: Rust XPCOM callback ownership.
